vps_acceptance.environment: AlmaLinux 9.8 (Olive Jaguar) x86_64, 2 vCPU, 3.5 GB RAM, 35 GB disk, disposable fresh VPS 2.29.114.9

disclosures.native_device_unverified: No native-device acceptance was performed for this release: the eight required cells (REALITY and Hysteria2, Wi-Fi and cellular, signed-in and Incognito) are UNVERIFIED, as are Russian-network reachability and 900 s native YouTube playback.
disclosures.eu_exit_youtube_shorts: YouTube Shorts do not play through the EU exit tested (91.244.71.165): 0/6 headless, answered 'unavailable'. The Russian exit played 15/16 headless Shorts, which is not device evidence. Shorts depend on each exit IP and are not guaranteed on any exit.
disclosures.os_tier: Production use so far is on Ubuntu 24.04 (best-effort tier); AlmaLinux 9 is the supported tier and was exercised by the lifecycle run recorded here.
disclosures.uninstall_lock_residue_after_update: In a supplementary run (v1.4.0-rc.1 updated to v1.4.0-rc.2) the harness's residue audit FAILED twice for the same reason: uninstall left one empty file, /run/lock/singbox-vpn-update.lock (tmpfs, removed at reboot). The update, failed-repair rollback, egress, backup and restore stages of that run passed. Not fixed in this release.
disclosures.bidirectional_pairing_on_real_hosts: Both directions were verified on two live Ubuntu hosts at v1.4.0-rc.1 (docs/qualification/2026-10-26/BIDIRECTIONAL_DEPLOYMENT.md); no real second-host pairing was part of the AlmaLinux lifecycle run.
